classification: dirty-tree signed-worker diagnostic; not release qualification
signing_scope: Apple Development signed worker bundle; parent recorded by executable SHA-256
implementation: Shared native DOM pattern constraints drive ValidityState, CSS selectors/computed style, form submission and OIL semantic validation flags.
Uses existing agent V8 isolate with lazy private context, UnicodeSets expressions and whole-value anchoring; authored source validated before wrapping.
Page RegExp constructor/prototype poisoning and page RegExp statics cannot control or observe validation execution.
Isolate slot owns native service teardown before V8 Dispose; retained matcher returns retired-engine error.
Live pattern reflection, six supported input states, unknown-type fallback, empty-value exemption, multiple-email token matching, invalid-syntax ignoring.

limits.note: V8 backtrack-ceiling exhaustion returns conservative mismatch; engine/resource/retirement errors propagate rather than report valid. Private context may internally retain RegExp subject state until replaced or destroyed; it is inaccessible to page JS and is destroyed with the isolate. No claim of arbitrary-complex-pattern completion or zero internal retention.

tests.targeted: Private context, poisoned page methods/statics, Unicode sets, invalid source escape, surrogate UTF-16, bounds, cache churn, backtrack termination, isolate retirement, native OIL observation mutation, CSS and submission recovery.
tests.timing_scope: Test-run elapsed times with overlapping work, not performance qualification.

oil.scope: OIL types the application reference and submits. A separate stdin-controlled server oracle rejects invalid reference syntax independently, verifies exact ordered receipt fields and requires receipt GET reload. Negative case verifies zero POSTs; recovery exactly one accepted POST. Version 4 adds a field and two cases, not identical-fixture comparison with version 3.

smoke.scope: Existing controlled observation/error smoke, not independent full-workflow qualification.
